actors.name: Donald Trump
actors.blurb: President Trump is dominating news coverage through executive actions, including launching a U.S. Space Academy, issuing an order to rename Lake Ontario to 'Lake America', and pursuing a major oil deal with Venezuela. His administration is also generating significant headlines around immigration enforcement, legal actions over state policies, and trade disputes with Canada.
